title: 抽蓄水庫水位調度
summary: 本課從上下庫逐時水量守恆開始，將庫容、水位、淨水頭、機組效率與電能連成可追溯帳本。十個單元分別處理抽水與發電方向、往返效率、可用時數、爬坡積分、天氣損失和期末預留，要求學徒在每個時間步查兩庫限制，並把慢速排程與快速水錘模型分開驗證。
summaryEn: Starting with paired-reservoir conservation, this course connects storage, level, net head, machine efficiency and energy in a traceable ledger. Ten units distinguish pumping and generation, cycle efficiency, duration, ramps, weather exchange and terminal reserves. Apprentices check both reservoirs at every step and verify slow scheduling separately from rapid waterway transients.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創水頭敏感度：固定流量100m³/s、總發電效率0.90與密度1000kg/m³，淨水頭385m時功率為339.9165MW。如果其他假設維持不變而淨水頭提高10%至423.5m，功率為373.90815MW，正好提高10%。這不表示真實機組可突破額定容量，也不表示水頭提高後效率必然固定。學徒應把新工況放回效率曲線、流量與電氣容量限制，再沿上下庫水位歷時積分電能。若要求固定功率，流量會反向調整，不能仍用原先水量帳本，且需重新檢查管路瞬態與進水條件。
workedExample.textEn: Original head sensitivity: with discharge100m³/s, overall generating efficiency0.90 and density1000kg/m³ fixed, net head385m gives339.9165MW. Raising net head by10% to423.5m while holding the other assumptions fixed gives373.90815MW, exactly10% higher. This does not permit exceeding nameplate capacity or establish constant real-machine efficiency at the new head. Place the new condition on the efficiency map and check discharge and electrical limits before integrating energy along the reservoir-level histories. If constant power is required instead, discharge changes inversely; the original water ledger no longer applies and transient and intake conditions must be checked again.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「雙庫水量帳本」與「水位庫容換算」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Paired reservoir water balance" and "Level and storage conversion": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 雙庫水量帳本：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Paired reservoir water balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「雙庫水量帳本」如何影響抽蓄水庫水位調度的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Paired reservoir water balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Reservoir-level scheduling for pumped storage”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 抽蓄把水在上下庫之間搬移，不會因為發電而消耗同等體積的水，但外部入流、蒸發與放流仍要分別列帳。每個時間步都應同時更新兩庫，明確約定流量正方向；只看上庫水位容易掩蓋下庫已滿或總水量不守恆的排程錯誤。 假設無外部交換，發電流量100m³/s持續1800s，上庫減少180000m³、下庫增加同量，兩庫合計不變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「雙庫水量帳本」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pumped storage transfers water between reservoirs without consuming the transferred volume through generation, although external inflow, evaporation and release remain separate terms. Update both reservoirs at every interval with explicit flow signs. Tracking only the upper level can hide a full lower reservoir or a schedule that violates total water conservation. Assume no external exchange and generation flow100m³/s for1800s. Upper storage falls180000m³ while lower storage rises equally, preserving their combined volume. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Paired reservoir water balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要日終上庫水位正確就不需要檢查下庫逐時水量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A correct final upper-reservoir level removes any need to check lower-reservoir storage through time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「雙庫水量帳本」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Paired reservoir water balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：只要日終上庫水位正確就不需要檢查下庫逐時水量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A correct final upper-reservoir level removes any need to check lower-reservoir storage through time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「雙庫水量帳本」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Paired reservoir water balance" is correct?
options: 只要日終上庫水位正確就不需要檢查下庫逐時水量。
抽蓄把水在上下庫之間搬移，不會因為發電而消耗同等體積的水，但外部入流、蒸發與放流仍要分別列帳。
同樣的移水量在上下庫必定造成完全相同的水位變化。
optionsEn: A correct final upper-reservoir level removes any need to check lower-reservoir storage through time.
Pumped storage transfers water between reservoirs without consuming the transferred volume through generation, although external inflow, evaporation and release remain separate terms.
The same transferred volume must produce identical level changes in both reservoirs.
quiz.explanation: 抽蓄把水在上下庫之間搬移，不會因為發電而消耗同等體積的水，但外部入流、蒸發與放流仍要分別列帳。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pumped storage transfers water between reservoirs without consuming the transferred volume through generation, although external inflow, evaporation and release remain separate terms. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 雙庫水量帳本：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Paired reservoir water balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙庫水量帳本」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Paired reservoir water balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設無外部交換，發電流量100m³/s持續1800s，上庫減少180000m³、下庫增加同量，兩庫合計不變。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume no external exchange and generation flow100m³/s for1800s. Upper storage falls180000m³ while lower storage rises equally, preserving their combined volume. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立上庫與下庫兩欄逐時帳本，逐一核對抽水及發電符號並把外部交換獨立列出。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build separate time-step ledgers, checking pumping and generating signs and listing external exchanges explicitly.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume no external exchange and generation flow100m³/s for1800s. Upper storage falls180000m³ while lower storage rises equally, preserving their combined volume.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「雙庫水量帳本」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Paired reservoir water balance", which statement holds?
options: 額定發電容量足夠就保證任意水位都能連續輸出相同功率。
只要輸出電量除以當日抽水電量超過一就證明儲能效率超過百分之百。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。
optionsEn: Adequate nameplate capacity guarantees identical continuous output at any reservoir level.
Output exceeding the same day’s pumping input proves a storage efficiency above one hundred percent.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 雙庫水量帳本：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Paired reservoir water balance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雙庫水量帳本」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Paired reservoir water balance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立上庫與下庫兩欄逐時帳本，逐一核對抽水及發電符號並把外部交換獨立列出。以兩庫總量閉合差找單位或漏項錯誤，再確認每步結果沒有超過個別可用容積邊界。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build separate time-step ledgers, checking pumping and generating signs and listing external exchanges explicitly. Use total-volume closure to locate unit errors or omissions, then confirm each step remains inside both reservoirs’ individual usable-storage bounds. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立上庫與下庫兩欄逐時帳本，逐一核對抽水及發電符號並把外部交換獨立列出。以兩庫總量閉合差找單位或漏項錯誤，再確認每步結果沒有超過個別可用容積邊界。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build separate time-step ledgers, checking pumping and generating signs and listing external exchanges explicitly. Use total-volume closure to locate unit errors or omissions, then confirm each step remains inside both reservoirs’ individual usable-storage bounds.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將同一流量在兩庫都列成流出會製造虛假耗水，反過來都列入流又會創造水量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Entering a transfer as outflow from both reservoirs invents losses, while dual inflow creates water. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「雙庫水量帳本」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Paired reservoir water balance"?
options: 建立上庫與下庫兩欄逐時帳本，逐一核對抽水及發電符號並把外部交換獨立列出。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
爬坡期間總水量正確就能證明任何閥門動作都不會產生水錘。
optionsEn: Build separate time-step ledgers, checking pumping and generating signs and listing external exchanges explicitly.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A correct total ramp volume proves that every associated valve movement is free of water hammer.
quiz.explanation: 建立上庫與下庫兩欄逐時帳本，逐一核對抽水及發電符號並把外部交換獨立列出。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build separate time-step ledgers, checking pumping and generating signs and listing external exchanges explicitly. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 雙庫水量帳本：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Paired reservoir water balance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雙庫水量帳本」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Paired reservoir water balance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將同一流量在兩庫都列成流出會製造虛假耗水，反過來都列入流又會創造水量。日終總量碰巧正確也不能證明中途下庫未經溢流或超界。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Entering a transfer as outflow from both reservoirs invents losses, while dual inflow creates water. A correct daily total does not prove that intermediate lower-reservoir storage avoided overflow or other boundary violations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設無外部交換，發電流量100m³/s持續1800s，上庫減少180000m³、下庫增加同量，兩庫合計不變。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Upper storage falls180000m³ while lower storage rises equally, preserving their combined volume.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要日終上庫水位正確就不需要檢查下庫逐時水量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A correct final upper-reservoir level removes any need to check lower-reservoir storage through time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 將同一流量在兩庫都列成流出會製造虛假耗水，反過來都列入流又會創造水量。日終總量碰巧正確也不能證明中途下庫未經溢流或超界。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「雙庫水量帳本」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Paired reservoir water balance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
將同一流量在兩庫都列成流出會製造虛假耗水，反過來都列入流又會創造水量。

optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Entering a transfer as outflow from both reservoirs invents losses, while dual inflow creates water.
The same transferred volume must produce identical level changes in both reservoirs.
quiz.explanation: 將同一流量在兩庫都列成流出會製造虛假耗水，反過來都列入流又會創造水量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Entering a transfer as outflow from both reservoirs invents losses, while dual inflow creates water. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 可用水量與時數：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Usable volume and duration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Reservoir-level scheduling for pumped storage”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 儲能時數受可移動水量及可接受流量共同限制，不等同於水庫總容積除以任意大流量。死水位、下庫空間、最低淹沒深度和保留需求會縮小可用範圍；長時間輸出還會改變水頭，所以等流量時數只提供第一層水量檢核。 假設已扣保留量的可移水量720000m³、定流量100m³/s，t=720000/100=7200s即2h；不保證定功率兩小時。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「可用水量與時數」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Storage duration is limited by transferable water and feasible discharge, not total reservoir volume divided by any desired flow. Dead storage, lower-reservoir room, intake submergence and reserved water reduce the usable range. Head changes during a long release, so constant-discharge duration provides only the first water-balance check rather than constant-power endurance. Assume transferable volume720000m³ after reservations and constant discharge100m³/s. Duration7200s equals2h, without guaranteeing constant electrical power throughout. steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Terminal inventory and reservation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 完美預報假設會讓預留不足的方案看似可行，期末缺水又會被截斷時域隱藏。若兩個備援服務同時到來，共用一份預留水量的承諾便無法全部履行。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Perfect-forecast assumptions can make inadequate reserves seem feasible, while horizon truncation hides terminal shortage. If two reserve services arrive together, promises backed by the same water inventory cannot both be fulfilled. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設上庫可用800000m³，其中預留200000m³，其他條件允許時最多移出600000m³；兩項服務不能重複使用同一預留量。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同一份預留水量可以同時保證任意多個獨立備援服務。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The same reserved water can simultaneously guarantee any number of independent backup services." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
